description: Valid file with last 64 bytes (seal) modified - bit flip at byte 0 of seal
tampering: The first byte of the 64-byte HMAC-SHA512 master seal is XORed with 0x01, flipping the least significant bit. The seal covers all bytes from offset 0 through the end of the last ciphertext block. A single bit change in the seal invalidates the HMAC verification.

expected.failure_step: Step 10 of verification: compare computed seal with stored seal
expected.failure_detail: HMAC-SHA512 recomputed over file bytes does not match the stored (tampered) seal
expected.blocks_note: Seal verification happens before block decryption; no blocks are decrypted
